items.t: TD Cowen Maintains Hold on Teladoc Health, Raises Price Target to $8
items.sum: TD Cowen analyst Charles Rhyee maintains Teladoc Health (NYSE:TDOC) with a Hold and raises the price target from $6 to $8.

items.t: Responsiv Announces New Healthcare & Insurance Offerings to Tackle Complex State-by-State Regulations
items.sum: CHICAGO, November 12, 2026--Responsiv, the regulatory change management and intelligence platform, today announced its dedicated Healthcare & Insurance offerings, helping organizations stay ahead of regulatory change and identify compliance gaps across complex jurisdictions. The offerings build on Responsiv’s existing work with healthcare and insurance organizations across the United States.

items.t: Hims & Hers Drops 18% as Q3 Loss and Profit Outlook Cut Disappoint; Novo Nordisk Slides 2%, Eli Lilly Holds Steady
items.sum: Revenue jumped nearly 49%, yet Hims & Hers investors fled anyway. Behind the selloff sit shrinking margins, a subscriber slip, and a bet on branded GLP-1 drugs the company doesn't even make.
